data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean HD 2D game FX sprite sheet with exactly 2 rows by 2 columns, four frames total, on a solid #FF00FF chroma-key background. The sheet should be a single image with four equal cells arranged in a perfect 2x2 grid, but DO NOT draw any guide lines, borders, labels, frames, safe-area marks, or UI. Each animation frame must be centered in its cell, consistent scale, and contained within the central 65% of that cell so nothing crosses cell edges.

Subject: a compact bomb-trigger explosion effect that would play directly on top of a playing card face. Effect only — no playing card, no UI, no text, no icons.

Frame 1 (top-left): tight white-hot ignition at the center, small intense core, minimal glow.
Frame 2 (top-right): bright amber-gold blast core with teal-white sparks and a stronger glow.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): expanding glowing ring with short radial burst strokes, energetic and readable.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): fading ember fragments and light streaks, dissipating glow, fewer particles.

Style: hand-painted game VFX, high contrast, crisp readable silhouette at small card size, luminous, polished, 2D, no realism, no smoke that fills the whole cell, no elements outside each frame’s bounds. Keep the explosion compact and centered in each cell, with clear progression across the four frames. Outside the effect in every cell must remain solid #FF00FF.
